overview_preview_generation.method: Full-frame RGB16 sources, ICC-linear box reduction covering every pixel, shared native-crop tone recipes, sRGB WebP navigation images with crop outlines

raw61_scope_note: The RAW61 baseline is the first ARW inside the same 16-frame PixelShift sequence, not an independently captured RAW61 storage-budget pair.

view_modes.description: ICC-managed rendered RGB; no automatic display stretch.
view_modes.label: Normal

view_modes.description: Expands the reference's darkest 12% of linear luminance as grayscale. Shared calibration; no candidate exposure fitting.
view_modes.label: Shadow recovery

view_modes.description: Expands reference linear luminance between percentiles 88 and 99.8 as grayscale. Shared calibration; no candidate exposure fitting.
view_modes.label: Highlight separation

view_modes.description: Reference-normalized linear RGB transmission, log density, fixed channel balance and strong contrast. A mathematical stress proxy, not a film-specific inversion.
view_modes.label: Hard negative-density inversion

view_modes.description: The same density proxy with a fixed lift of its lower positive values. This measures edit sensitivity, not recovered capture latitude.
view_modes.label: Hard inversion with shadow lift
